description: Agent-native messaging API for chats, messages, attachments, phone numbers, contact cards, capability checks, and webhooks

novel_features.name: Encrypted PHI local mirror
novel_features.description: Caches Linq chats and messages in an encrypted local mirror with PHI-shaped searchable text redacted and retention purge support.

novel_features.name: Welcome Flow Planner
novel_features.description: Composes invite-link, secure-link audit, consent audit, safe reply draft, guarded send, and monitoring into one dry-run plan for RonanRx onboarding.

novel_features.name: Inbound-first guarded send
novel_features.description: The only intended outbound agent path; refuses cold sends, opted-out recipients, PHI-shaped content, and non-HTTPS links with no cold-send override.

novel_features.name: Send preflight
novel_features.description: Explains whether guarded send would be allowed without sending or touching Linq.

novel_features.name: Safe reply draft
novel_features.description: Creates a redacted human-review reply draft and never sends it.

novel_features.name: Consent audit
novel_features.description: Summarizes local inbound and opt-out evidence for a chat before patient-adjacent automation.

novel_features.name: Human escalation triage
novel_features.description: Surfaces conversations with opt-out, urgent, medical, or frustrated language for human review.

novel_features.name: Pointer link audit
novel_features.description: Checks message links for HTTPS, allowlisted host policy, and PHI-shaped URL content.

novel_features.name: Click-to-text invite link
novel_features.description: Builds an inbound front-door link carrying routing text and an opaque token/link only.

novel_features.name: Operational insight layer
novel_features.description: Provides local operational views over the encrypted messages/chats mirror.
